use: Tubular / coil reactor with continuous feed and inline UV monitoring of the outlet.
simulation: Coil split into segments (plug-flow approximation), each advancing the reaction by residence time; outlet flow cell reads absorbance.
model: R-Series (R2+ pump module / R4 reactor module)
notes: Reference model profile: continuous-flow reactor (two pumps + 10 mL PFA coil + back-pressure regulator)
Spec values not individually verified (verified = false). Back-mixing is approximated by a number of CSTRs in series (segments), a model assumption.
sources: Vapourtec R-Series product literature (to be archived and checked)

spec.coil: 10 mL PFA coil (1 mm ID), can be used as two 5 mL coils in series with a T-piece in between for a third feed

to_calibrate: Inline UV flow cell pathlength (with standards of known concentration)
Actual coil volume (tracer residence time distribution)

set_flow.description: Set feed flow rates (mL/min); feed_a / feed_b mix at the coil inlet, feed_c (optional) is added at the coil midpoint (between the two sections)

set_temperature.description: Set coil temperature; temperature_2 (optional) is the temperature of the second section (after the midpoint)

set_uv_wavelength.description: Set the detection wavelength of the outlet inline UV flow cell (2 mm path, before the back-pressure regulator)

collect_start.description: Switch the outlet to the collection vessel (port out)

collect_stop.description: Switch the outlet back to waste

alternatives.model: Vapourtec R-Series (R2+ pump module / R4 reactor module)
